purpose: Preview only, not applied to game
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE cohesive color character concept board for a 2D browser arena game, landscape 3:2, preview only.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing monochrome warrior identity and diamond-shaped armor motif reference, NOT the final palette or drawing style. Image 2 is the required round FACELESS battle silhouette reference. Image 3 is the approved elf archer concept board; use its polished painterly fantasy illustration quality and clear asset-board presentation, NOT its elf/forest character design.
Primary request: completely redesign the warrior's art in believable realistic colors, showing full standing character, matching portrait avatar, faceless round battle unit, and a separately displayed longsword. A handsome adult human male warrior with tousled short dark brown hair, human ears, serious composed expression in portrait. He wears functional layered plate armor with strong silhouette, a diamond crest, weathered steel surfaces, muted brass fittings, brown leather belts, a dark burgundy shoulder cape/tabard and padded cloth. Natural warm skin, desaturated blue-gray steel with subtle reflected colors, dark wine red fabric, restrained antique bronze accents. Believable materials, not monochrome, no neon.
Composition: left 44% a complete full-body standing illustration, large enough for character selection, elegant grounded stance and unobstructed armor. Upper middle a square head-and-shoulders avatar of EXACTLY the same man with matching equipment. Lower middle a large round battle unit plus a small thumbnail to demonstrate 64px readability. Right a clean isolated sword in full side profile, intact silhouette, clearly separated from body, no hands. Sword has steel blade, modest bronze crossguard and diamond emblem, brown leather handle; a practical weapon that can be rotated in the game.
Critical battle unit constraint: one near-circular sphere, not a chibi humanoid. No eyes, no eyebrows, no nose, no mouth, no face or expression, no limbs. Smooth uninterrupted cool blue-gray spherical surface above a curved chestplate wrapping the lower half, small dark brown hair crest, burgundy cloth wrap at base and one restrained bronze diamond crest. Armor decoration must not look like eyes or a mouth. Consistent palette and identity with the full-body warrior; high readability at small size.
Style: sophisticated hand-painted game illustration, soft realistic material rendering and crisp silhouettes, comparable level of finish to Image 3, not a photo, not thick monochrome ink outlines. Off-white parchment presentation background with understated fine-line diamond ornaments. Balanced negative space. No scene or UI screenshots.
Text (verbatim): main title "战士"; section labels "头像", "战斗形态", "长剑". No other text. All four parts must be fully visible, no cropped head, feet, sword or sphere. This is one cohesive sample board, not separate production assets.
